name: ProPresenter
description: A ProPresenter controller on the Home pages: pictures of the current and next slide, next and previous, clear, timers and the stage message, plus cards for every timer, audience messages, and macros and Looks.
author: JPMixer

settings.label: ProPresenter computer’s address
settings.help: Its IP address, as ProPresenter shows it under Settings → Network. Leave blank if ProPresenter runs on this computer.

settings.label: Port
settings.help: The Port under ProPresenter → Settings → Network, with Enable Network on.

settings.label: Running timers at the top of the pages
settings.help: While a ProPresenter timer runs, it shows under the header of every Home page and next to the clock on the Green Room screen.
